key_insight: Three iterations of practical Direct Nash Optimization improved length-controlled win rates against GPT-4o from 31.7% to 45.3% for Llama 3.1 8B and from 6.8% to 18.4% for Mistral 7B.
engineering_relevance: Same-family open-weight annotators retained 62% of Llama’s and 82% of Mistral’s gains achieved with GPT-4o annotation, offering a nonproprietary option for the rating step.
method: Sample responses on-policy and rate them alongside a teacher’s gold response.
Select large-margin preference pairs and apply a DPO-style contrastive update.
Repeat training to approximate a two-player preference-game Nash equilibrium.
evidence_signal: On AlpacaEval 2.0 with GPT-4o judging, the tuned Llama 3.1 8B exceeded Llama 3.1 70B Instruct on every reported win-rate metric.
watch_item: All results are single runs, and using GPT-4o as both teacher and evaluation judge may favor alignment to that model’s preferences.
paper_title: Aligning Language Models with General Preferences: An Empirical Study of Direct Nash Optimization
